1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Schema meets file, state, and model here; the gate forces shapes, closed objects, and field parity to answer to all three without re-deciding any. Its four edges span two cells — three prose parents (natural→code) and one specification parent (structured→code) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up). The target is the change the operation acted on: the state model's `target: int` (owolyrmp) has no empty counterpart, so the gate reads an empty target as a shape failure rather than a permitted value.
